messages:
lia-support: Customer (AcmeCorp) opened a high priority ticket — users can't SSO after SCIM sync yesterday, plus they say audit logs don't show any KMS key usage for bulk exports. saying it's a compliance blocker.
sam-customer-success: Customer says >100 users failed to sign-in after SCIM run at 02:14 UTC, error shown is 'SAML_RESPONSE_INVALID_SIGNATURE'. They need timeline and root cause.
kevin-eng: ok adding context — we rolled SCIM patch 2026-02-24 02:10 UTC that changed group mappings. Could be attribute mismatch or assertion signing config. Repro steps please.
lia-support: sent customer repro request. They pasted SAML response snippet and SCIM change summary. Also attached a curl of their SSO IdP failing calls:

```
curl -v -X POST https://idp.acme.example/sso -d @saml_resp.xml
* Server returned error: 403 Forbidden
* Response: <Status>urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:status:Responder</Status>
```

lia-support: They also pasted our audit export job logs which show no KMS decrypt calls for that export window (02:00-03:00 UTC). They fear exported PII wasn't logged.
maria-security: missing KMS logs is concerning. Our KMS/HSM access audit should log Encrypt/Decrypt events. @kevin-eng can you check the KMS client integration layer for any swallow/retire of audit events around the SCIM rollout?
kevin-eng: looking now. quick check: service account for exports used key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123:key/abcd-ef - last recorded use at 01:58 UTC, then nothing. Our runtime shows repeated 403 from KMS at ~02:12-02:16, same window as SCIM job.
sre-bot: Deploy notice: canary deploy of scim-service v2.3.1 started at 02:09 UTC across 3 pods.
kevin-eng: hmm can reproduce locally by running SCIM provisioning against a federated IdP with metadata that contains a trimmed cert. SAML lib returns invalid signature if whitespace changed. But that wouldn't affect KMS. Two separate failures maybe correlated by timing.
lia-support: customer also reports billing spike (they saw many auth retries increasing API calls). They flagged it to finance.
sam-customer-success: customer is legally required to provide audit trail for the export, escalation to security + compliance requested.
maria-security: action items: 1) preserve all raw logs for 48h (do not auto-delete), 2) capture network traces for exports 02:00-03:00, 3) rotate service account key only if necessary after forensics. Who can fetch KMS audit events from CloudTrail?
kevin-eng: I'll pull CloudTrail and our runtime-side KMS client logs. Preliminary hypothesis: canary deployed a config that swapped env var KMS_ENDPOINT to a staging endpoint which returned 403 for production key, causing client retries and no decrypts. That would explain missed audit entries because decrypt never happened.
lia-support: customer provided the SCIM patch diff — group mapping rename + new environment flag SCIM_USE_NEW_KMS_ENDPOINT=true. they claim they didn't set KMS env but we might have defaulted it in the canary.
kevin-eng: copying runtime config now:

```
env SCIM_USE_NEW_KMS_ENDPOINT=true
KMS_ENDPOINT=https://kms-staging.internal
```

kevin-eng: that's the smoking gun. Canary picked up staging endpoint via config propagation bug. production exports attempted decrypt against staging KMS which rejected the key -> 403 -> no CloudTrail decrypt events for prod key.
maria-security: good find. next: capture all requests to /kms/* for 02:08-02:20, preserve the canary pod containers, snapshot disk and KV cache for forensic review. Also prepare a timeline to share with customer.
sre-bot: Action created: SRV-1159 preserve-pods (assigned to kevin-eng)
kevin-eng: taking pod snapshots, collecting CloudTrail. Also will patch canary config to unset SCIM_USE_NEW_KMS_ENDPOINT and redeploy canary rollback.
lia-support: communicated initial root cause: mis-propagated KMS endpoint in canary causing decrypts to fail and creating SSO surface noise because the SCIM job triggered identity changes while IdP logs still in flight. Customer wants if data was exposed or not.
maria-security: no evidence of exposure — staging KMS rejected requests. However need to prove no plaintext left on disk and no export completed. I'll run integrity checks and verify export job status: in our export-job table, all exports in 02:00-03:00 are in FAILED state with error 'kms:AccessDenied'.
sam-customer-success: customer asked about least-privilege review of service account after this. They want assurance that SCIM/export service only has decrypt privileges for specific key and cannot access others.
kevin-eng: agreed. plan: scope down IAM role to key policy with key-id scim-export-key only, add kms:ViaService condition for the export lambda, and add a guardrail that prevents non-prod endpoints in prod namespaces.
maria-security: I'll own the policy change PR and request an emergency audit to verify no other services had similar env leak. Also recommend HSM/KMS rotation plan if needed.
lia-support: sent timeline + next steps to customer: preserve logs, we will provide CloudTrail slices, pod snapshots, and policy remediation steps. They acknowledged receipt and want compliance pack.
kevin-eng: quick repro notes for eng team in case it helps: 1) enable SCIM_USE_NEW_KMS_ENDPOINT in prod canary 2) run export job for customer with key ARN not present in staging 3) observe 403 from staging KMS and CloudTrail shows no decrypt for prod key 4) see SAML invalid signature errors on concurrent login attempts due to idp metadata collisions.
maria-security: closing loop: once we provide CloudTrail slices and pod artifacts, schedule a 1:1 with AcmeCorp security next week. Also open a ticket to add automated alert if our deploy config references non-prod KMS endpoints in prod clusters.
lia-support: customer said they'll hold regulatory filing until we deliver artifacts. marking this P1 and will keep you looped. :lock:
kevin-eng: rollback done, canary reverted. collecting final artifacts and will upload to secure dropbox for security review.
sre-bot: Upload notice: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-secure/forensics/SRV-1159/ (restricted).
